title: Fabada Asturiana with Spanish Beans
description: A hearty Spanish stew originating from Asturias, made with fabada beans, chorizo, and morcilla.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chorizo and morcilla and cook, breaking up the meat with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the fabada beans, red wine, water, and smoked paprika. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Fabada Asturiana hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
